summary: Implemented JSON pretty printing in the rich repository, without committing or running anything. Changes: new rich/json.py (JSON renderable plus main-guarded CLI); JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; docs (console.rst "Printing JSON" section, new reference/json.rst, reference.rst toctree entry); CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; new tests/test_json.py. Choices: overflow set to Python None because "none" is not a valid OverflowMethod. Gaps: tests were not run, and the truecolor ANSI output is not asserted exactly; the tests check plain text and Span positions instead.
